name: file-hash
title: File Hash
description: Streaming BLAKE3 and SHA-256 hashing for file integrity checks and exact-duplicate detection in datasets.

usage.python:
from kura_rs import file_hash

# A file, streamed with constant memory (the GIL is released while reading)
digest = file_hash.hash_file("blake3", "model.safetensors")
print(digest)  # lowercase hex

# Same as hashlib.sha256(b"abc").hexdigest()
file_hash.hash_bytes("sha256", b"abc").hexdigest()

# Incremental, like hashlib
h = file_hash.Hasher("sha256")
h.update(b"a")
h.update(b"bc")
h.hexdigest()

# Exact-duplicate detection: digests are hashable
unique = set(file_hash.hash_files("sha256", paths))
